title: Support worker
intro: Support NDIS participants at home, in the community, in respite and in registered SIL providers' homes. Day, evening, weekend, overnight and sleepover shifts.
duties: Personal care and daily living support
Supporting participants' goals, choices and independence
Shift notes and reporting to the provider
need: NDIS Worker Screening Check (or willing to apply)
Working With Children Check where the role needs it
nice: Certificate III or IV in Individual Support or Disability
Driver licence and a comprehensively insured car
Manual handling and medication assistance training
